content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Installation ## slug: payments-fsl-install-setup-installation ## seoTitle: Installation ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End The first step is to install the latest extension packages and complete the setup process. ## Enable the Field Service Package 1. Navigate to Setup > Field Service Settings. 2. Click **Enable**. ![P_02_Package Setup pic 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/P_02_Package%20Setup%20pic%201.png){height="" width=""} 4. If you update any of the settings, click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ## Install the SF Field Service Managed Package If you haven't installed the Field Service Managed Packaged yet, install it now. (You can install the managed package in a production or sandbox org). Click [SF Field Service Managed Package](https://d36000000z1fneac.my.salesforce-sites.com/install){target="_blank"} and follow the prompts to install the managed package in your org. ## Install the BT FSL Mobile Pay Extension **Prerequisite:** To install the latest FSL Extension package, you must have Payments Version 5.31 or higher. Install the latest [Blackthorn Payments Mobile FSL Extension Package](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/fsl-release-notes){target=`_blank`}.
